snippet.title: "The Silence: Deep Sleep" - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
The Silence: Deep Sleep - Official Reveal Trailer

Experience the weight of absolute silence.

"The Silence: Deep Sleep" is a first-person psychological horror game developed by SilenDevOfficial. Navigate a world where the boundary between reality and nightmare is indistinguishable, and where silence is your only sanctuary—or your greatest threat.
